rationale: Price is in active freefall — the last five 1-minute candles show a clean staircase lower from $26.41 to $25.69 on accelerating volume (peaking at 308K shares), with the current price sitting at only 23.8% of today's range and well below both the 9-EMA ($26.61) and session VWAP ($26.33). There is no evidence of a stabilizing base or reversal structure to support a long, and shorting into a move that has already dropped ~$1.26 from the open high with no consolidation risks chasing exhaustion. Waiting for a defined structure — either a bounce with a clear rejection level for a short entry, or a base formation with volume dry-up for a long — is the higher-probability path.
